note: Captured by `npm run verify:plugin-registry -- --update`. Manifests are the released manifest.json of each latestVersion.

plugins.name: Currency Exchange Rates
plugins.author: scalpelpoe
plugins.description: Easily monitor exchange rates for currency. Pretty straightforward.

plugins.name: PoE Event Log
plugins.author: scalpelpoe
plugins.description: A clean, filterable feed of in-game events (zones, levels, deaths, whispers, trade) parsed live from the PoE client log, in a pop-out overlay window.

plugins.name: Scalpel Importer
plugins.author: juddisjudd
plugins.description: Import PoBs, pobb.in links, and official Path of Exile .build files directly inside Scalpel.

plugins.name: .ini Editor
plugins.author: scalpelpoe
plugins.description: Edit your production_Config.ini. If you dare.

plugins.name: Plugin Examples
plugins.author: scalpelpoe
plugins.description: Showcase of every visual component the Scalpel plugin SDK ships, plus a hotkey to copy and inspect the hovered item.

plugins.name: Scalpel OCR
plugins.author: scalpelpoe
plugins.description: OCR hotkey for Well of Souls affix tiers and Runeshape Combinations reward pricing (layout row detection + per-row masked OCR)

plugins.name: Loot Tracker
plugins.author: cccarv82
plugins.description: Track loot per session and map. Live value via poe.ninja, drops/hour, top items, export to JSON/CSV.

plugins.name: Cluster Back
plugins.author: scalpelpoe
plugins.description: Large Cluster Jewel finder for PoE1. Pick some desired notables, then find and search trade for options that put a trash notable in back.

plugins.name: Map Mod Check
plugins.author: BurtonCameron
plugins.description: Hover a map, press a hotkey, and get a Good / Warn / Bad verdict beside your cursor, pre-flagged by Scalpel's map-mod danger scale.

plugins.name: Hideout Hunter
plugins.author: xmopi
plugins.description: Makes finding rare hideouts easy by letting you know if a map you entered spawned a hideout.

plugins.name: Calculator
plugins.author: scalpelpoe
plugins.description: A calculator. Like, to do math with. For currency exchange math. Or whatever else.

plugins.name: Scalpel Quest Tracker
plugins.author: eniner
plugins.description: PoE2 campaign checklist with leveling, endgame, and crafting guides — zone follow, progress export, and Waystone-style UI.

plugins.name: Scalpel DPS
plugins.author: eniner
plugins.description: PoB-style weapon compare for PoE1 and PoE2 — Ctrl+C import, attack and spell DPS, dual-slot deltas.

plugins.name: Now Playing
plugins.author: scalpelpoe
plugins.description: Windows Only. See and control what's playing - Spotify, YouTube, or most media players. Album art, track details, play/pause and skip.

plugins.name: Scalpel Strats
plugins.author: eniner
plugins.description: PoE2 Atlas farming strategies, Expedition Aldur's rumour checker, and useful links
